report:
Final settings: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0. Final throughput: 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms, within the 200 ms hard limit.

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.
Method: searched every integer setting (batch_size 1 to 9, workers 1 to 29, prefetch 0 to 39) with bench.py's own measure function and kept only settings with p99 at or under 200 ms (the hard limit in SPEC.md, never traded). The best was 4 / 14 / 0. Then set config.json and ran python bench.py to confirm.
Measured: python bench.py prints "throughput 700.0 req/s, p99 199.0 ms (within the 200 ms limit)".
Note: higher throughput exists only past the 200 ms limit, so it was not used. The bench is a model; the margin to the limit is 1 ms.
